name: Misato (Saitama, Japan, town)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Misato town emblem in white: a ring with a pointed top enclosing a stylised three-armed device.
history: Municipal flag of Misato, a town in Saitama Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 August 1967.

features.role: Misato town emblem — a ring with a pointed top enclosing a stylised three-armed device
